Class RunnerJarSpec.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.RunnerJarSpec.Builder
Enclosing class:
RunnerJarSpec
public static final class RunnerJarSpec.Builder extends Object
Describes a runner jar step by step.

The builder is mutable and is not thread safe; build() takes a snapshot of it, so it can be reused afterwards.

Since:
1.0

    • entryStub

      public RunnerJarSpec.Builder entryStub(boolean value)
      Requests a generated entry stub.

      Setting this to true asks the packager to generate the stub only when the base main class, and every selectable multi-release variant when multiRelease(boolean) is enabled, is directly callable: a public, non-abstract class in a named package that declares its own public static void main(String[]). An ineligible class or a collision with the generated class name is reported and uses the launcher's reflective fallback instead. Setting this to false always uses that fallback.

      The raw builder defaults to false. The Gradle and Maven plugins default to true.

      Parameters:
      value - whether to generate the stub when the main class is eligible
      Returns:
      this builder

    • manifestAttributes

      public RunnerJarSpec.Builder manifestAttributes(Map<String,String> value)
      Sets extra main attributes for the manifest.

      This method preserves iteration order. An unordered map such as one returned by Map.of(Object, Object, Object, Object) can iterate differently in separate JVMs; use a deterministically ordered map or canonicalManifestAttributes(Map) when archive bytes must be reproducible across build JVMs.

      Parameters:
      value - the attributes, in the order they should be written
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the map, a key or a value is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a key is Manifest-Version, Main-Class or in the Micronaut-Runner-* namespace, ignoring case

    • canonicalManifestAttributes

      public RunnerJarSpec.Builder canonicalManifestAttributes(Map<String,String> value)
      Sets extra main attributes in canonical order.

      Names are written in their natural lexicographic order, which is locale independent, so maps with equal entries produce the same manifest bytes regardless of their iteration order. Manifest attribute names are case insensitive; two names that differ only by case are therefore rejected rather than choosing one value based on source-map order.

      Parameters:
      value - the attributes to write in canonical order
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the map, a key or a value is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a key is reserved, or two keys differ only by case

    • addOpens

      public RunnerJarSpec.Builder addOpens(List<String> value)
      Sets the Add-Opens values.

      Each entry must use JAR manifest syntax, module/package. Do not append the command-line-only =ALL-UNNAMED target.

      Parameters:
      value - the module/package pairs, one pair per list entry
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the list or an element is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if an entry is not a single, whitespace-free module/package pair
